aegworldwide-aegworldwide:greenhouse:797.description: For more than 20 years, AEG has played a pivotal role in transforming sports and live entertainment. Annually, we host more than 160 million guests, promote more than 10,000 shows and present more than 22,000 events around the world. We are committed to innovation, artistry, and community, and leverage the power of our 300+ venues, leading sports franchises, marquee music brands, integrated entertainment districts, premier ticketing platform and global sponsorship activations, to create memorable moments that give the world reason to cheer. Our business is interwoven with the human mind and heart, and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive company that reflects the artists, athletes, and fans that we host; reach beyond traditional boundaries to support the communities in which we operate; and minimize our impact on the environment by adopting sustainable practices throughout our business operations. If you want to be challenged to up your game and make a difference, then join us in giving the world reason to cheer! CONVERSION CREW SUMMARY The Conversion Crew provides support to the Operations department in regard to event setup, changeovers, general facility maintenance, and daily operational tasks. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES Physically assist with event setup, changeovers, and daily operational tasks including but not limited to setting up, breaking down, and properly storing items such as tables, chairs, portable stages, and dancefloors. Work with Custodial Supervisor on day to day tasks. Assist Operations and Event Managers on relevant event/operation related information. Other operational responsibilities assigned as needed. Strong organizational skills with ability to multi-task. alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:c43f8b.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field. Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think Iron Man’s Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use. Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber. We’re building the future of human-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started. As an Engagement Manager, you'll own Siro deployments with the Enterprise field sales teams we serve. You will plan and execute our large customer pilots, engagements that typically last 60-90 days, alongside an Account Executive. We see this function as a competitive differentiator: the deployments you’ll run will be Enterprise pilots, and often times are head-to-head against competitors. To be successful, you will be a true internal cross-functional owner, coordinating across Sales, Data Science, Solutions Eng, and more. You will be exceptional at managing external and internal stakeholder relationships. And you will be exceptional at ensuring that all levels of the customers we serve get value from Siro. This is a full-time role in New York City. In this role, you will provide legal support across corporate governance, subsidiary management, corporate transactions, securities, treasury, tax, and compensation matters. Partner with Tax, Treasury, HR, Accounting, external legal counsel, advisors, and agents on governance matters, information requests, and corporate records. Provide legal support across securities and stock exchange compliance, public debt offerings and redemptions, banking and credit facility matters, share buyback programs, incentive and equity compensation matters, and other corporate legal projects. Qualifications: 2–12 years of relevant legal experience, with a focus on corporate governance, subsidiary governance, corporate transactions, or related corporate legal matters. Compensation: The estimated total compensation for full-time Axiom attorney roles is $114,000-250,000 per year and for non-attorney roles is $64,000-201,000 per year. cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:0d0.team: 046 - Carlsbad - Sur La Table, 1915 Calle Barcelona, Space #130, Carlsbad, CA 92009
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:0d0.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. The Culinary Lead contributes to the success of a Sur La Table store by inspiring customers on all points of their culinary journey. The Culinary Lead blends culinary talent, business acumen and teaching skills to support the Resident Chef in driving business results and the staffing and performance management of all culinary employees. The Culinary Lead reports to a Resident Chef.
responsibilities: Models and directs employees to ensure customer service standards are met.
Delivers and holds employees accountable for an exceptional cooking class experience at every class using recipes and game plans provided.
Contributes to an environment where employees are informed and capable by supporting and/or delivering training for all employees.
Maintains proper storage, prep and service procedures and maintains all equipment and workspaces to ensure sanitary conditions.
Ensures all food items are cooked and served at the correct temperature.
Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to employees, maintained and consistently followed.
Provides coaching in the moment and performance feedback to culinary employees.
Seeks opportunities to increase cooking class and retail sales and directs culinary employees to execute sales plans.
Anticipates and solves problems by taking decisive action, follows up with the Resident Chef.
Stays informed by maintaining product knowledge, accesses available training and seeks out additional resources when necessary.
Ensures the accuracy and integrity of employee information including, but not limited to, Time and Attendance records and personal data.
Appropriately partners with Resident Chef, HQ Culinary Team, Human Resources and other departments as needed or necessary.
Demonstrate exceptional verbal and written communication skills with employees, customers, field management and corporate office.
Ensures adherence to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT policy.
May handle, serve, and pour liquor, wine and beer and/or mix ingredients, such as liquor, soda, water and etc. in order to prepare cocktails and other drinks.
Additional responsibilities as assigned by Resident Chef.
qualifications: 1-2 Years progressively responsible kitchen operations or kitchen management experience.
Culinary degree or equivalent Sous Chef experience considered in lieu of degree.
Valid Food Handlers / Food Managers Certification.
Must be at least 21 years old.
Familiarity with MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
Demonstrated successful teaching and training experience.
Proven ability to drive sales and motivate teams.
Proven leadership and financial management skills.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:2da14b12-7f49-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Test Manager based in Ireland. This is a senior testing leadership opportunity within a fast-growing, international digital environment spanning insurance, e-commerce, and device protection. You will lead testing activities across a major technical delivery programme involving multiple projects, teams, and external partners. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on QA leadership, giving you significant influence over quality standards and delivery outcomes. You will oversee the complete testing lifecycle across SIT, UAT, and ORT, while working across both Agile and Waterfall environments. As a testing SME, you will define methodologies, mentor teams, manage risks, and ensure robust quality gates. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced QA leader who enjoys complexity, collaboration, and driving continuous improvement. Lead and coordinate testing activities across multiple concurrent projects, delivery streams, internal teams, and external partners. Own the end-to-end testing lifecycle, from test planning and scenario development through execution, defect management, reporting, and test closure. Define and maintain testing strategies, plans, goals, closure reports, and other key testing artefacts. Manage and oversee SIT, UAT, and ORT activities, ensuring appropriate quality gates are achieved at each stage. Collaborate closely with QA Leads, engineers, project managers, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors to align testing activities with programme objectives. Act as a testing Subject Matter Expert, providing guidance on testing methodology, risk management, test design, and phase-specific approaches. Support resource management and step into hands-on QA responsibilities when required. Drive improvements to testing processes, tools, and practices using lessons learned, retrospectives, and industry best practices. Monitor testing progress, risks, issues, dependencies, and, where applicable, costs, providing clear status reporting to stakeholders. Demonstrated experience across the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), including SIT, UAT, and ORT. Previous hands-on experience as a QA Lead, Test Lead, or QA Engineer, with the ability to contribute technically when required. Strong experience coordinating multi-stream teams, external partners, and third-party vendors. Extensive practical knowledge of JIRA and Confluence for project tracking, documentation, and test management. Experience with test automation and at least one recognised industry-standard automation framework. Strong capabilities in test planning, test case and scenario development, defect management, test data management, and quality reporting. Comfortable working across both Agile methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban, and Waterfall delivery models. Experience working with sensitive customer data and an understanding of relevant testing and data-handling considerations. Good knowledge of testing methodology, insurance/device protection, or e-commerce; experience in insurtech, fintech, or regulated digital platforms is an advantage. Ability to understand, interpret, and validate business and application requirements within complex digital environments. Strong communication, stakeholder management, leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Full professional fluency in English and Spanish , both written and spoken. Experience with AI, API, or RPA technologies, introducing testing tools, or working within a testing Centre of Excellence is a plus. Benefits: Remote working opportunity within Europe. jobgether-jobgether:lever:c543df37-9a15-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Community Science – Analyst based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to use research, evaluation, data, and community engagement to address complex real-world challenges. You’ll contribute to projects that help organizations and communities become healthier, more equitable, and more resilient. Working alongside experienced consultants, you’ll support engagements from research and data collection through analysis, reporting, and implementation. You’ll work across multiple projects and subject areas, gaining exposure to diverse clients, communities, and strategic challenges. The position combines analytical work with writing, presentations, stakeholder engagement, and project coordination. It’s an environment suited to curious, collaborative professionals who value continuous learning and meaningful impact. You’ll have opportunities to take increasing ownership while helping translate evidence into practical solutions that create lasting change. Research and evaluation: Support qualitative and quantitative research activities, including survey development, interviews, focus groups, literature reviews, document reviews, and other data collection methods. Data management and analysis: Collect, organize, clean, manage, and analyze qualitative and quantitative data using tools such as Excel, R, SPSS, or comparable research software. Client insights: Help interpret findings, identify meaningful patterns, and translate research into practical insights and recommendations for clients and communities. Writing and deliverables: Draft reports, memos, proposals, presentations, technical documents, and other client-facing materials tailored to different audiences. Data visualization: Develop clear charts, tables, infographics, and other visual materials that communicate research findings effectively. Presentations and engagement: Support client meetings, presentations, discussions of findings, technical assistance, training, and capacity-building activities. Project coordination: Coordinate tasks, timelines, deliverables, and priorities across multiple projects while maintaining quality and proactively communicating progress or emerging needs. Team collaboration: Work closely with colleagues across practice areas, contribute ideas and solutions, participate in project meetings, and seek guidance when appropriate. Proposal development: Contribute to proposals by coordinating activities, preparing supporting materials, drafting sections, and helping produce high-quality submissions. Professional contribution: Maintain an approximately 85% project utilization target and participate in approved professional development and internal practice initiatives. Requirements: Education and experience: Bachelor’s degree in public health, public policy, sociology, psychology, education, social work, or a related social science discipline; a master’s degree is preferred. Relevant experience: At least 3 years of professional experience in research, evaluation, consulting, community engagement, capacity building, or a related field. Research capabilities: Demonstrated experience collecting, organizing, managing, and analyzing qualitative and/or quantitative data, as well as conducting interviews, focus groups, surveys, or similar research activities. Analytical skills: Strong critical thinking, analytical reasoning, problem-solving, and research synthesis capabilities. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and adapt materials for different audiences. Project management: Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities simultaneously. skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a1a235d3-9077-415e.title: Product Marketing Manager - Growly
skelar-skelar:ashbyhq:a1a235d3-9077-415e.description: [https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png] Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Зараз ми в пошуку Product Marketing Manager для нашої портфельної компанії Growly. Про бізнес Growly: Growly — глобальна продуктова компанія, яку рухають виняткові команди. Наш принцип простий: ніхто не перемагає наодинці. Змінюються продукти і ринки — але сильна команда досягає результатів знову і знову. Тому для нас не так важливо, що робити. Важливо — з ким, ми збираємо команди, які разом перетворюють амбітні ідеї на реальність. Сьогодні ми розвиваємо три напрями в межах одного бренду: — Інструменти для роботи з документами — редагування, конвертація, підписання і захист файлів в одному місці. — Платформа для розвитку когнітивних навичок — тренування памʼяті, уваги та швидкості мислення через науково обґрунтовані тести й практики. — Платформа для розвитку карʼєри — резюме та мотиваційні листи, пошук вакансій і підтримка на кожному етапі карʼєрного розвитку. Класні продукти будують не вакансії, а люди. Тому ми не «закриваємо позицію» — ми шукаємо людину, яка підніме планку команди — можливо, це ти. Це роль, в якій ти будеш: — Працювати з маркетинг-воронками з фокусом на пошукову рекламу; — Вести та розвивати процес A/B-тестування – PMM відповідає за повний цикл A/B-тесту: від генерації та пріоритезації гіпотез до дизайну експерименту, запуску, координації із залученими командами, аналізу результатів та оцінки ефекту; — Проводити конкурентний аналіз та шукати insights – системно відслідковувати конкурентів, ринок та поведінку користувачів, виявляти нові можливості для зростання; — Тісно співпрацювати з командами product, marketing, контенту, дизайну та розробки для реалізації маркетингових ініціатив та тестів. Що для нас важливо: — Сильні аналітичні здібності — досвід роботи з даними, статистикою, метриками; вміння бачити за цифрами потребу юзера та робити висновки; — Дослідження ринку та пошук інсайтів — вміння знаходити, що насправді болить у користувача, і трансформувати це у меседжі та value proposition; — Практичний підхід до гіпотез — здатність оцінювати пріоритет та потенційний імпакт гіпотези; — Комунікаційні навички — вміння пояснити свої ідеї команді так, щоб їх зрозуміли і підхопили; — Гнучкість і проактивність — вміння працювати у швидкому та висококонкурентному середовищі, де ринок і кампанії змінюються кожен тиждень. Як ми працюємо — наші цінності Openness — Be Brave. Embrace Change. Value Feedback. Сміливість говорити правду й чути інших — навіть коли незручно. Ownership — Take charge. Deliver results. Тут не питають «де мій KPI» — тут приходять з «я бачу, як зробити краще». Bias for Action — Quick Moves, Big Wins. Приймаємо рішення швидко й любимо дію більше за нескінченні узгодження. weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:3c4c7167-5fb.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com ROLE OVERVIEW We are looking for a Polish Linguistic Lead Tester to join a long-term project in Cupertino, CA. As a Linguistic Lead Tester, you’ll help bring high-quality Polish content to life and ensure it feels natural, accurate, and polished for end users. The Onsite Lead Tester is responsible for the overall quality of their language at an account level, as well as the main point of contact for Language Leads. This role is ideal for someone with native-level fluency in Polish, fluency in English, and strong communication skills. We’re looking for someone who is comfortable working with customers and stakeholders at different levels, can provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback, and confidently present information and respond to questions from managers, clients, customers, and linguists. The ideal candidate also enjoys supporting and training others, sharing knowledge, and helping the team grow, and is available to work full-time. MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES Linguistic tasks Coordination of the linguistic team, like for example: Reviews copy and gives feedback to testers; communicates feedback received from the client Supports testers in understanding corrections resulting from the arbitration process Acts as liaison for terminology, style issues, product features & questions Supports the onboarding of new testers Identifies linguistic-specific training needs for the language; creates, maintains, and delivers the linguistic training program Quality management planning and execution Client engagement Linguistic assets management Complete assigned tasks in a quality and timely manner. REQUIREMENTS Onsite in our offices in Cupertino, CA. W-2 (eligible for benefits based on hours worked). Monday-Friday (8:30 am - 4:30 pm, with a 1-hour lunch break, 35 hours per week). To be eligible for this role, you’ll need a valid visa permitting you to work in the USA. IDEAL BACKGROUNDS: Marketing, Journalism, Copy Editing, Proofreading, Writing, Translation, and/or Localization Benefits: ▪️ Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity Insurance ▪️ Telemedicine Benefit ▪️ Paid Sick Time ▪️ Paid Holiday ▪️ Employee Assistance Program Following the eligibility requirements: ▪️ Medical Insurance ▪️ Dental Insurance ▪️ Vision Insurance ▪️ HSA ▪️ Voluntary Life Insurance ▪️ 401(k) Retirement Plan Hourly rate: $40 Job Reference: #LI-JC1
